profile.headline: Member of Technical Staff III @ Selector AI | Distributed Systems | Cloud Infrastructure | Go & Python | AWS • GCP • Azure
profile.summary: Dedicated Software Engineer with extensive experience in programming, framework development, deployment, and database management. Proficient in Python, Go, JavaScript, and a suite of modern technologies. Passionate about developing scalable applications and optimizing system performance through innovative solutions.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff III (MTS-3)
positions.description:
⦁ Drive the architecture and development of scalable backend and distributed systems powering AI-driven network observability, infrastructure monitoring, and telemetry collection.

⦁ Design and extend a multi-cloud monitoring platform across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure, supporting cloud resource discovery, inventory collection, and infrastructure metrics.

⦁ Architect cloud-native data collection services with a focus on efficient API polling, workload scheduling, batching, rate-limit management, and large-scale resource monitoring.

⦁ Develop cross-account cloud telemetry ingestion designs involving AWS S3, SQS, Kafka, and ClickHouse, supporting reliable processing of network flow logs.

⦁ Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of containerized microservices deployed on Kubernetes, with a focus on resilient data pipelines and production infrastructure.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff II (MTS-2)
positions.description:
⦁ Designed and developed CloudPoller, a multi-cloud infrastructure monitoring framework for discovering cloud resources, collecting operational metrics, and integrating telemetry into Selector's observability platform.

⦁ Built cloud monitoring integrations for GCP and AWS, including resource discovery, authentication, cross-account access, API integrations, and infrastructure metric collection.

⦁ Developed and enhanced network telemetry collection services using gNMI, SNMP, and OpenConfig, enabling structured monitoring of network devices and infrastructure.

⦁ Designed Go-based microservices for cloud data collection, scheduling, workload distribution, and communication between distributed services.

⦁ Developed and maintained event-driven data processing and telemetry pipelines using Apache Kafka, supporting reliable integration between backend services.

⦁ Improved service interoperability, configuration management, and operational reliability across Kubernetes-based environments, working with Prometheus, MongoDB, and etcd.

⦁ Contributed to backend modernization, performance optimization, API design, and improvements to distributed service reliability.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff I (MTS-1)
positions.description:
⦁ Designed, developed, tested, and maintained backend microservices for a network observability and infrastructure monitoring platform using Python and Go.

⦁ Contributed to migrating backend components from Python to Go, improving the foundation for efficient and scalable service execution.

⦁ Built RESTful APIs and service integrations using FastAPI, supporting communication between distributed microservices and backend systems.

⦁ Developed database integrations and data processing workflows using MongoDB and Python-based services.

⦁ Containerized and deployed backend applications using Docker and Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

⦁ Collaborated with engineering teams to troubleshoot production issues, improve service reliability, and support the development of scalable backend infrastructure.

positions.title: Back-end Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Contributed to the development of the Newsroom product by creating APIs that provide in-depth analysis of Click-through rates across various timelines. My role encompassed the development and rigorous testing of APIs dedicated to data storage in HBase. This process was enhanced through the utilization of Apache Spark for data aggregation and Apache Kafka for efficient data queuing, ensuring seamless data flow and integrity.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Engineered and implemented a sophisticated automated ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipeline, designed to refine data for enhanced analysis and predictive modeling. Successfully deployed this comprehensive pipeline on Azure, leveraging the aztk Python library to fully automate the data processing workflow, ensuring efficiency and reliability in data handling.

positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As a Teaching Assistant for DATA 255 - Deep Learning Technologies in the Data Science Department, I played a crucial role in collaborating with the professor to design the course curriculum, ensuring it met educational standards and objectives. Additionally, I was responsible for the assessment and grading of student assignments and exam papers, contributing significantly to maintaining the academic rigor and quality of the course.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Associate
positions.description: As a Teaching Associate for ME 30 - Computer Applications in the Mechanical Engineering Department, I specialized in instructing students on the fundamentals of Python programming. This included practical applications, notably implementing code on the Circuit Playground Express by Adafruit, thereby bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world technical skills.

company.name: EZDI, Inc - an AGS Health company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed an innovative end-to-end learning model by synergistically combining BI-LSTM (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) and CRF (Conditional Random Field) algorithms. This advanced integration yielded a notable 2% increase in precision over traditional statistical algorithms, marking a significant enhancement in the model's performance and accuracy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Conducted a comprehensive analysis of the stacking method through the integration of various classifiers, and benchmarked its performance against bagging and boosting algorithms. This approach not only enhanced the model's accuracy by 5% but also significantly reduced training time when compared to conventional Neural Network methodologies.
